Doctor Polaris is basically a living magnet, e as such he functions like one, losing his “charge” when exposed to extreme Calor, recharging com kinetic Energia, susceptible to Magnético fields, etc.
Doctor Polaris is a second personality within Neal Emerson. Both personalities wrestle for control.
